question: Which organisation was formed by Henry Dunant, the winner of the first Nobel Peace Prize in 1901?

options.text: Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons

solution:
The correct answer is __**International Red Cross**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The International Red Cross was founded by Henry Dunant, who was awarded the first Nobel Peace Prize in 1901 for his role in founding this organization.
 
• The International Red Cross aims to provide humanitarian aid and emergency assistance, disaster relief, and education.
 
• The organization is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and operates worldwide.
 
• The International Red Cross has a mission to protect human life and health, ensure respect for all human beings, and prevent and alleviate human suffering.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW)**

 
 
• An intergovernmental organization that aims to eliminate chemical weapons and prevent their use through the implementation of the Chemical Weapons Convention.
 
• Headquartered in The Hague, Netherlands.
 
• Received the Nobel Peace Prize in 2013.
 
 
 
• **World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF)**
 
 
• Founded in 1961, it is an international non-governmental organization working in the field of wilderness preservation and the reduction of human impact on the environment.
 
• Headquartered in Gland, Switzerland.
 
• Focuses on issues such as climate change, endangered species, and sustainable practices.
 
 
 
• **Medecins Sans Frontieres (Doctors Without Borders)**
 
 
• An international humanitarian medical non-governmental organization known for its projects in conflict zones and in countries affected by endemic diseases.
 
• Founded in 1971 in Paris, France.
 
• Provides medical care, training, and infrastructure in affected regions.
